On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name NLC Tamilnadu Power Limited Account No. 31037748056 IFSC Code SBIN0003143 Bank Name State Bank of India Branch address SPIC Nagar, MUTHIAPURAM, TUTICORIN, TAMILNADU, PIN- 628005 . Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PQR Conditions a. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS: a.i. Clause 1: The bidder should be the owner/lessee of a lime stone Quarry (or) The bidder should be deale r/agent of the lessee of a lime stone quarry/any back-up limestone quarry. a.ii. Clause 2: The bidder should have supplied minimum 25500 MT of Limestone to one or more firms in a maximum of three orders within the last seven years prior to the original scheduled date of tender openi ng. b. FINANCIAL REQUIREMENTS: b.i. Clause 1: Average annual turnover of the bidder for the 3 financial years immediately preceding the ori ginal scheduled Tender Opening date, should not be less than Rs 846.93 Lakhs. b.ii. Clause 2: The bidder shall have positive net worth as per the latest standalone audited financial state ment. c.i NOTE: I. Technical Requirements:

1. Clause 1 - In case of an OWNER/LESSEE, it is required to provide copies of the notary affidavit of mining l essee approval /owner deed, for the quarry location, valid for a minimum Eighteen (18) months from the s cheduled date of tender opening (or) In case of a dealer / agent of the lessee, it is required to provide copi es of notary affidavit of the dealership certificate and lease agreement shall be furnished with the validity period of minimum Eighteen (18) Months from the scheduled date of tender opening. 2. Clause 2 - The documentary evidence for having supplied Limestone in a maximum of three orders with in the last Seven years to any firms as on the scheduled date of tender opening in the form of Purchase or ders and its corresponding Supply execution certificate completion issued by the end user/ Performance ce rtificate issued by the end user/ Copies of invoices acknowledged by the end user for having received the material and also that have been certified by chartered accountant shall be submitted to satisfy the above pre-qualification requirements. 3. Copy of valid certificates/licences attested by Notary public or Gazetted officer or Practicing Charted Ac countant in Original. 4. The bidder shall be a Proprietary firm/ Partnership firm/ a firm (Private, public, Govt) registered under C ompany’s act. 5. The bidder should meet the criteria specified in all the PQR clauses of Technical & Financial aspects. c.ii NOTE: II. Financial Requirements: 1. Copies of standalone audited financial statement (Profit & Loss account and Balance Sheet) for three fin ancial years immediately preceding the original scheduled tender opening date are to be furnished to mee t the PQR mentioned in clause b.i & b.ii Otherwise the offer is liable for rejection. 2. In case, if a bidder meets the technical QR but could not furnish his/their standalone audited financial sta tement of three consecutive financial years preceding the last financial year for evaluating the average An nual Turnover, due to the incorporation/formation of the bidder, with in a period of less than 3 years from t he original scheduled date of tender opening then, such bidder shall also be considered and the Average a nnual turnover of such bidder shall be arrived as below: a. If the bidder furnished standalone audited financial statement (Profit & Loss Account and Balance Sheet) for the last financial year only, then such bidder’s average Annual Turnover shall be arrived at by dividing t he Turnover of the last financial year by Three. b. If the bidder furnished standalone audited financial statement (Profit & Loss Account and Balance Sheet) for the last two financial years only, then such bidder’s average annual turnover shall be arrived at by divi ding the sum of the last two financial years by Three. 3. In cases, where standalone audited financial statement (Profit & Loss Account and Balance Sheet) for th e last financial year immediately preceding the original schedule date of tender opening are not available, a certificate would be required from the bidder stating that the financial statement of bidder are under aud it as on the date of tender opening. In such cases, the standalone audited financial statement of the three consecutive financial years preceding the last financial year shall be considered for evaluating the financial parameters. Buyer Added ATC Clause 1: The Delivery schedule is as per para 2.4, 2.5 and 2.6 in Annexure-I attached in Buyer uploaded ATC docu ment. Clause 2: Quality will be ascertained by the testing of the required Chemical Compositions from BIS Lab/ BIS Accredit ed Lab/ NABL Lab/ NABL Accredited Lab. Clause 3: Test certificates for chemical compositions issued by the Testing agency should be enclosed with every co nsignment while delivering the material to NTPL site. Clause 4:

The sellers have to provide acceptence for the Technical specifications and Terms and conditions for Anne xure-1 attached in Buyer uploaded ATC document. Clause 5: The seller's Evaluation and Quantity allocation as per para 3.1 in Annexure-I attached in Buyer uploaded A TC document. Clause 6: The sellers have to submit the relevent documents supporting to the Pre Qualification Requirement (PQR) as per the PQR Conditions mentioned above. Clause 7: Local Content Certificate for MII is to be Duly filled, Signed, stamped and certified by chartered accountant in practice (format attached in Buyer uploaded ATC document), with percentage value of local content (Fo rm-4) Clause 8: Integrity Pact: Original stamped, signed, sealed (in all pages) hard copy of integrity pact should be sent to the following a ddress immediately. DGM- PURCHASE, PURCHASE DIVISION, NLC TAMILNADU POWER LIMITED, 2x500 MW THERMAL POWER PLANT, HARBOUR ESTATE, TUTICORIN, TAMIL NADU – 628004. Clause 9: Bidders shall note that the GeM Portal captures and displays the Internet Protocol (IP) address from which the bidder has submitted the BID. The received bids having matching / Common IP addresses of bidders s hall be outrightly rejected and shall not be considered for evaluation. Clause 10: All the payments will be made within 45 days from the appointed day i.e. -From the date of delivery of goo ds or rendering of services: Or -Where any objection is made in writing by the buyer regarding acceptance of goods or Services within 15 days from the day of the delivery of goods or the rendering of service, the d ay on which such objection is removed by the supplier. Through e-payment to the Bank Account of the supplier as mentioned in the GeM Order Summary TReDS Condition: All the MSME payments will be made through TReDS service platform within the stipulat ed time. Payment Conditions: All payments shall become due and payable only after submission of following guaran tees by the bidder if applicable: I. Contract Performance Bank Guarantee. II. General Guarantee for Warranty III. Test certificates or any other certificates and acceptance of the same by the Purchaser. Clause 11: The price should not be disclosed in Technical Cover. If disclosed then the seller's offer will be rejected. .
